 Cyprus Football Association Delegation Pays Tribute to Armenian Genocide Victims in Yerevan
 Cyprus Football Association Delegation Pays Tribute to Armenian Genocide Victims in Yerevan
 Football 
 💬 
 Comment
 Nov. 12, 2026, 2:57 p.m. 
 Author:
 Vahe Hakobyan 
 Sportaran 
 Ahead of the UEFA Nations League match between Armenia and Cyprus, a delegation from the Cyprus Football Association visited the Tsitsernakaberd Armenian Genocide Memorial Complex in Yerevan.
 The delegation was led by Cyprus Football Association President Haris Loizides .
 Representatives of the Cypriot federation laid a wreath at the memorial dedicated to the victims of the 1915 Armenian Genocide, paying tribute to those who lost their lives.
 The visit took place ahead of the fifth-round match in Group C2 of the 2026/27 UEFA Nations League between the national teams of Armenia and Cyprus.
 The Armenia vs Cyprus match will take place today, November 12, at the Vazgen Sargsyan Republican Stadium in Yerevan. Kickoff is scheduled for 21:00 local time.
